item.title: Ep. 133 - Profit Is For The Customer [Business 300]
item.description: Customers won’t trade their money for the product if they perceive the price too high for the quality offered. That information is vital for the Seller. The Seller must hear what the Buyer wants. That happens from the pursuit of profit. The Seller's free pursuit of profit enables value for the Buyer. And so, profit is for the customer.
item.author: Philip Kulishov
item.itunes:author: Philip Kulishov

item.title: Ep. 132 - Results Follow Trade-offs [Business 300]
item.description: Business people are after results. Actually, everybody's after results. It's just that a business makes it very clear if you have results or not. And, as in all things, results in this trade follow trade-offs. There is good. And there is better. Real results are better than good intentions. For you to have results, you must trade something. That's because, results follow trade-offs.
item.author: Philip Kulishov

item.title: Ep. 131 - You Want Your Customers To Take You For Granted [Business 300]
item.description: If your customers are not constantly praising you for everything you do, that is in itself a silent recognition of a job well done. You’ve done it again. You want your customers to take you for granted.

item.title: Ep. 130 - Why To Uncover Your Mission [Business 300]
item.description: All business consultants will tell you that you need to uncover the mission of your business. You need to know "the why." You need to know what your business exists for. But, what for? Why do you need to know "the why?" Why uncover the Mission? Find out in this Episode.
